_comment: Raw live capture: workflow_list_runs({limit:100}) on 2026-08-25, filtered to drop the 11 independent_node/trial_reg_*/node_run_* rows (regression-trial and single-node runs, not real workflow runs -- same exclusion the old fixture README documented). All 55 remaining rows are the FULL real run history (31 publishing_conductor, 18 capture_conductor, 6 clone_conductor) so count-derived UI text (e.g. per-workflow "needing attention" totals) matches live truth. Each row's `nodes[]` is trimmed to {nodeId,status} only (dropping warnings/lastDispatch/produces/durationMs/skip detail -- verbose per-attempt telemetry not read by any adapter) and `mode` is trimmed to {executionMode} (dropping its long human-readable notice string) -- every field actually consumed by api/adapters.ts's toRun() is kept verbatim. See fixtures/README.md.
